--!strict
-- Discovery remains server-owned. This browser only presents the approved roster.
local Theme=require(script.Parent.UITheme)
local MenuLayout=require(script.Parent.MenuLayout)
local Shared=game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").PetRoll.Shared
local Catalog=require(Shared.PetCatalog)
local C=Theme.Colors
local Browser={}
Browser.__index=Browser

local GAP=14
local REST=UDim2.fromScale(0.5,0.5)
local WHITE=Color3.new(1,1,1)
local BLACK=Color3.new(0,0,0)

local function previewPosition(collected)
	return UDim2.fromScale(0.5,if collected then 0.44 else 0.5)
end

function Browser.new(app,parent)
	local self=setmetatable({
		app=app,parent=parent,cards={},connections={},pending={},alive=true,opened=false,columns=4,
	},Browser)
	local root=Theme.Frame(parent,"IndexBrowser",UDim2.new(1,-24,1,-24))
	root.Position,root.BackgroundTransparency,root.Visible=UDim2.fromOffset(12,12),1,false
	root:SetAttribute("OwnsPopupStyle",true)
	self.root=root

	-- One scrolling collection, no filters, selection controls, or information on missing birds.
	local grid=Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
	grid.Name,grid.Position,grid.Size="IndexGrid",UDim2.new(),UDim2.fromScale(1,1)
	grid.BackgroundTransparency,grid.BorderSizePixel,grid.ScrollBarThickness=1,0,6
	grid.ScrollBarImageColor3=Theme.ActionColors.navigation
	grid.AutomaticCanvasSize,grid.CanvasSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,UDim2.new()
	grid.ScrollingDirection,grid.VerticalScrollBarInset=Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y,Enum.ScrollBarInset.Always
	grid.ClipsDescendants,grid.Parent=true,root
	local padding=Instance.new("UIPadding")
	padding.PaddingLeft,padding.PaddingRight=UDim.new(0,24),UDim.new(0,24)
	padding.PaddingTop,padding.PaddingBottom=UDim.new(0,24),UDim.new(0,24)
	padding.Parent=grid
	local layout=Instance.new("UIGridLayout")
	layout.CellSize,layout.CellPadding=UDim2.fromOffset(248,248),UDim2.fromOffset(GAP,GAP)
	layout.SortOrder,layout.HorizontalAlignment=Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
	layout.Parent=grid
	self.grid,self.layout=grid,layout

	table.insert(self.connections,grid:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(function() self:Resize() end))
	table.insert(self.connections,root:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function() self:SyncVisibility() end))
	table.insert(self.connections,parent:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function() self:SyncVisibility() end))
	table.insert(self.connections,app.panel:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function() self:SyncVisibility() end))
	self:Resize()
	return self
end

function Browser:BuildCards()
	if next(self.cards) then return end
	for i,species in Catalog.Order do
		local slot=Theme.Frame(self.grid,"Entry_"..i,UDim2.fromOffset(248,248))
		slot.LayoutOrder,slot.BackgroundTransparency=i,1
		local visual=Theme.Frame(slot,"Visual",UDim2.new(1,-6,1,-6),WHITE)
		visual.Position,visual.AnchorPoint,visual.ClipsDescendants=REST,Vector2.new(0.5,0.5),false
		Theme.Stroke(visual,Theme.Arcade.border,3)
		local scale=Theme.Motion:Scale(visual)
		local studs=Theme.Studs(visual,0.15,32,3)
		local inset=Theme.Frame(visual,"InnerRim",UDim2.new(1,-8,1,-8))
		inset.Position,inset.BackgroundTransparency,inset.ZIndex=UDim2.fromOffset(4,4),1,4
		local rim=Theme.Stroke(inset,C.white,1)
		rim.Transparency=0.42
		local preview=self.app:Preview(visual,{species=species,stars=1,level=1},
			UDim2.new(1,-18,1,-64),previewPosition(true))
		preview.ImageColor3,preview.ImageTransparency=BLACK,0
		preview.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(0.5,0.5)
		preview.ZIndex=3

		-- Larger portraits may overlap the card a little; captions stay readable in front.
		local caption=Theme.Frame(visual,"Caption",UDim2.new(1,-10,0,48),WHITE)
		caption.Position,caption.AnchorPoint,caption.ZIndex=UDim2.new(0,5,1,-5),Vector2.new(0,1),4
		local gradient=Theme.Gradient(caption,Color3.fromRGB(14,20,24),Color3.fromRGB(5,9,12))
		gradient.Transparency=NumberSequence.new(0.22,0.06)
		local name=Theme.Label(caption,"Name","",24,C.white)
		name.Position,name.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(6,2),UDim2.new(1,-12,1,-4)
		name.TextXAlignment,name.TextYAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
		name.TextScaled=true
		local textLimit=Instance.new("UITextSizeConstraint")
		textLimit.MinTextSize,textLimit.MaxTextSize,textLimit.Parent=18,24,name
		caption.Visible=false
		local view={root=slot,visual=visual,scale=scale,preview=preview,caption=caption,
			name=name,rim=rim,studs=studs,collected=nil}
		self.cards[species]=view

		local function hover(active)
			if not self.alive or not self.opened then return end
			local moving=active and not Theme.Motion.reduced
			Theme.Motion:Tween(scale,"index-scale",{Scale=if moving then 1.018 else 1},0.15)
			Theme.Motion:Tween(preview,"index-lift",{
				Position=previewPosition(view.collected==true)+UDim2.fromOffset(0,if moving then -4 else 0),
			},0.17)
			Theme.Motion:Tween(rim,"index-highlight",{Transparency=if active then 0.1 else 0.42},0.15)
		end
		table.insert(self.connections,visual.MouseEnter:Connect(function() hover(true) end))
		table.insert(self.connections,visual.MouseLeave:Connect(function() hover(false) end))
	end
end

function Browser:Resize()
	if not self.alive then return end
	-- Cancel the outer popup's animated scale when measuring the logical grid.
	local motionScale=self.app.panelMotionScale and self.app.panelMotionScale.Scale or 1
	local scale=math.max((self.app.uiScale or 1)*motionScale,0.01)
	local width=math.floor(self.grid.AbsoluteSize.X/scale+0.5)-54
	if width<=0 then return end
	local columns=math.clamp(math.floor((width+GAP)/(if width<500 then 156 else 224)),1,4)
	local cellWidth=math.max(1,math.floor((width-GAP*(columns-1))/columns))
	self.columns=columns
	self.layout.CellSize=UDim2.fromOffset(cellWidth,cellWidth)
	self.layout.FillDirectionMaxCells=columns
end

function Browser:StopMotion()
	for thread in self.pending do task.cancel(thread) end
	table.clear(self.pending)
	for _,view in self.cards do
		Theme.Motion:Cancel(view.scale,"index-scale")
		Theme.Motion:Cancel(view.visual,"index-enter")
		Theme.Motion:Cancel(view.preview,"index-lift")
		Theme.Motion:Cancel(view.rim,"index-highlight")
		view.scale.Scale,view.visual.Position,view.rim.Transparency=1,REST,0.42
		view.preview.Position=previewPosition(view.collected==true)
		local shine=view.visual:FindFirstChild("MotionShine")
		if shine then
			local gradient=shine:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("UIGradient")
			if gradient then Theme.Motion:Cancel(gradient,"shine") end
			shine.Visible=false
		end
	end
end

function Browser:Reveal()
	self:StopMotion()
	if Theme.Motion.reduced then return end
	local top,bottom=self.grid.AbsolutePosition.Y,self.grid.AbsolutePosition.Y+self.grid.AbsoluteSize.Y
	local order=0
	for _,species in Catalog.Order do
		local view=self.cards[species]
		local y=view.root.AbsolutePosition.Y
		if y+view.root.AbsoluteSize.Y>=top and y<bottom then
			view.scale.Scale,view.visual.Position=0.91,REST+UDim2.fromOffset(0,10)
			local thread
			thread=task.delay(math.min(order*0.035,0.24),function()
				self.pending[thread]=nil
				if not self.alive or not self.opened then return end
				Theme.Motion:Tween(view.scale,"index-scale",{Scale=1},0.28,Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
				Theme.Motion:Tween(view.visual,"index-enter",{Position=REST},0.24)
			end)
			self.pending[thread]=true
			order+=1
		end
	end
end

function Browser:SyncVisibility()
	if not self.alive then return end
	local visible=self.root.Visible and self.parent.Visible and self.app.panel.Visible and self.app.page=="Index"
	if visible and not next(self.cards) then return end
	if visible==self.opened then return end
	self.opened=visible
	if visible then self:Resize();self:Reveal() else self:StopMotion() end
end

function Browser:Render(_force)
	local state=self.app.state
	if not state or not self.alive then return end
	self:BuildCards()
	self:Resize()
	-- Apply the approved cyan header only to this page, without changing the shared palette.
	Theme.ApplyReferenceAccent(self.app.panelHeader,Theme.ReferenceGradients.Upgrades)
	local discovered={}
	for _,pet in state.pets or {} do
		if self.cards[pet.species] then discovered[pet.species]=true end
	end
	if type(state.discovered)=="table" then
		for _,species in Catalog.Order do
			if state.discovered[species]==true then discovered[species]=true end
		end
	end
	for _,species in Catalog.Order do
		local view=self.cards[species]
		local portraitScale=MenuLayout.Number(self.app.gui,"Index","PortraitScale",1.15,0.8,1.35)
		view.preview.Size=UDim2.fromScale(portraitScale,portraitScale)
		local collected=discovered[species]==true
		if view.collected~=collected then
			local newlyCollected=view.collected==false and collected
			view.collected=collected
			view.root:SetAttribute("Collected",collected)
			view.caption.Visible=collected
			view.name.Text=if collected then Catalog[species].name else ""
			view.preview.ImageColor3=if collected then WHITE else BLACK
			view.preview.Position=previewPosition(collected)
			if collected then
				local color=Theme.Rarities[Catalog[species].rarity] or Theme.ActionColors.navigation
				Theme.Gradient(view.visual,color:Lerp(WHITE,0.27),color:Lerp(Theme.Arcade.border,0.36))
				view.rim.Color=color:Lerp(WHITE,0.65)
				view.studs.ImageTransparency=0.82
			else
				Theme.Gradient(view.visual,Color3.fromRGB(117,131,136),Color3.fromRGB(67,78,85))
				view.rim.Color=Color3.fromRGB(176,194,201)
				view.studs.ImageTransparency=0.91
			end
			if newlyCollected and self.opened and not Theme.Motion.reduced then
				view.scale.Scale=0.94
				Theme.Motion:Tween(view.scale,"index-scale",{Scale=1},0.32,Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
				Theme.Motion:Shine(view.visual)
			end
		end
	end
	self:SyncVisibility()
end

function Browser:Destroy()
	self.alive,self.opened=false,false
	self:StopMotion()
	for _,connection in self.connections do connection:Disconnect() end
	table.clear(self.connections)
	self.root:Destroy()
	table.clear(self.cards)
end

return Browser

--!strict
-- Studio-owned Frames are the saved sizing controls. Client code never rewrites them.
local Layout={}
Layout.Names={Army="MyArmy",Shop="Shop",Index="Index",Upgrades="Upgrades",Settings="Settings",Odds="Odds",Merge="Fuse",Offline="OfflineEarnings"}
Layout.Defaults={
	Army={size=Vector2.new(0.54,0.82),maximum=Vector2.new(1100,780)},
	Shop={size=Vector2.new(0.64,0.80),maximum=Vector2.new(900,680)},
	Index={size=Vector2.new(0.66,0.80),maximum=Vector2.new(940,680)},
	Upgrades={size=Vector2.new(0.67,0.80),maximum=Vector2.new(950,660)},
	Settings={size=Vector2.new(0.46,0.80),maximum=Vector2.new(640,620)},
	Odds={size=Vector2.new(0.46,0.70),maximum=Vector2.new(640,560)},
	Merge={size=Vector2.new(0.39,0.82),maximum=Vector2.new(760,760)},
	Offline={size=Vector2.new(0.38,0.64),maximum=Vector2.new(520,440)},
}

function Layout.Control(gui,page)
	local folder=gui:FindFirstChild("MenuLayouts")
	return folder and folder:FindFirstChild(Layout.Names[page] or page)
end

function Layout.Number(gui,page,name,fallback,minimum,maximum)
	local control=Layout.Control(gui,page)
	local value=control and control:GetAttribute(name)
	return if type(value)=="number" and value==value then math.clamp(value,minimum,maximum) else fallback
end

function Layout.Size(gui,page,available)
	local definition=Layout.Defaults[page] or Layout.Defaults.Settings
	local control=Layout.Control(gui,page)
	local size=if control and control:IsA("GuiObject") then control.Size else UDim2.fromScale(definition.size.X,definition.size.Y)
	if available.X<900 or available.Y<550 then
		local compact=control and control:GetAttribute("CompactSize")
		if typeof(compact)~="Vector2" then compact=Vector2.new(0.94,0.92) end
		size=UDim2.fromScale(compact.X,compact.Y)
	end
	local limit=control and control:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("UISizeConstraint")
	local maximum=if limit then limit.MaxSize else definition.maximum
	local minimum=if limit then limit.MinSize else Vector2.new(300,240)
	local width=math.clamp(available.X*size.X.Scale+size.X.Offset,minimum.X,math.max(minimum.X,maximum.X))
	local height=math.clamp(available.Y*size.Y.Scale+size.Y.Offset,minimum.Y,math.max(minimum.Y,maximum.Y))
	return math.max(1,math.min(width,available.X-24)),math.max(1,math.min(height,available.Y-24))
end

-- Used only by the Edit-mode authoring tool. Existing user values are preserved.
function Layout.CreateControls(gui)
	local folder=gui:FindFirstChild("MenuLayouts")
	if not folder then
		folder=Instance.new("Frame")
		folder.Name,folder.Size,folder.BackgroundTransparency="MenuLayouts",UDim2.fromScale(1,1),1
		folder.BorderSizePixel,folder.Parent=0,gui
		folder:SetAttribute("PreviewMenu","MyArmy")
	end
	for page,name in Layout.Names do
		if folder:FindFirstChild(name) then continue end
		local definition=Layout.Defaults[page]
		local frame=Instance.new("Frame")
		frame.Name,frame.Size=name,UDim2.fromScale(definition.size.X,definition.size.Y)
		frame.Position,frame.AnchorPoint=UDim2.fromScale(0.5,0.5),Vector2.new(0.5,0.5)
		frame.BackgroundTransparency,frame.BorderSizePixel,frame.Visible=1,0,false
		frame:SetAttribute("CompactSize",Vector2.new(0.94,0.92))
		frame:SetAttribute("EditHelp","Size.X.Scale = width; Size.Y.Scale = height. SizeLimits caps large screens. CompactSize controls phones.")
		if page=="Index" then frame:SetAttribute("PortraitScale",1.15) end
		local limit=Instance.new("UISizeConstraint")
		limit.Name,limit.MinSize,limit.MaxSize,limit.Parent="SizeLimits",Vector2.new(300,240),definition.maximum,frame
		frame.Parent=folder
	end
	return folder
end

return Layout

local function frame(parent,name,size,position)

local function label(parent,name,text,size,position,bounds,color,prominent)
 local item=Theme.Label(parent,name,text,size,color or WHITE)
 item.Position,item.Size=position,bounds
 item.TextColor3,item.TextSize=color or WHITE,size
 item.TextWrapped,item.TextScaled=false,false
 item.TextTruncate=Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
 item.ZIndex=parent.ZIndex+4
 local function outline()
  item.TextOutline.Color=INK
  item.TextOutline.Thickness=math.clamp(item.TextSize*(if prominent then 0.065 else 0.05),1,4)
 end
 item:GetPropertyChangedSignal("TextSize"):Connect(outline);outline()
 return item

local function fitSingleLine(item,maximum,minimum)
 item.TextScaled,item.TextWrapped=false,false
 local function fit()
  local width=math.max(1,item.Size.X.Offset-4)
  local size=maximum
  while size>minimum and TextService:GetTextSize(item.Text,size,item.Font,Vector2.new(100000,100000)).X>width do
   size-=1
  end
  item.TextSize=size
 end
 item:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(fit)
 item:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Size"):Connect(fit)
 fit()
end

-- The inspector also needs to fit exact high-level prices and long chicken names.
local function fitInspectorLine(item,maximum,minimum)
 item:SetAttribute("MaximumTextSize",maximum)
 local function fit()
  local width=math.max(1,item.AbsoluteSize.X-16)
  local size=item:GetAttribute("MaximumTextSize") or maximum
  local text=item.Text:gsub("<[^>]+>","")
  while size>minimum and TextService:GetTextSize(text,size,item.Font,Vector2.new(100000,100000)).X>width do size-=1 end
  item.TextSize=size
 end
 item:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(fit)
 item:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(fit)
 item:GetAttributeChangedSignal("MaximumTextSize"):Connect(fit)
 fit()
end

local function inside(item,point)

local function scrollingPanel(parent,name)

function Browser:ColossalSlot(id)
	local pet=self.app:Pet(id)
	if not pet or not Giant.IsColossal(pet.giantSize) then return nil end
	for slot,otherId in self.app.state.selectedIds or {} do
		local other=self.app:Pet(otherId)
		if otherId~=id and other and Giant.IsColossal(other.giantSize) then return slot end
	end
	return nil
end


function Browser:OpenInventory()
	-- This is an explicit navigation action, never a state-refresh side effect.
	-- Inspection selection is local UI state; it does not equip or sell a chicken.
	if self.pending then return end
	local state=self.app.state
	if not state then return end
	self:CancelPointer(true)
	local pet=self.app:Pet(self.app.selected)
	if not pet then
		local equipped={}
		for _,id in state.selectedIds or {} do equipped[id]=true end
		local bestEquipped,bestPower=false,-math.huge
		for _,candidate in state.pets or {} do
			local isEquipped=equipped[candidate.id]==true or candidate.selected==true
			local power=Rules.PetPower(candidate.species,candidate.stars,candidate.level)
			if not pet or (isEquipped and not bestEquipped)
				or (isEquipped==bestEquipped and (power>bestPower or (power==bestPower and candidate.id<pet.id))) then
				pet,bestEquipped,bestPower=candidate,isEquipped,power
			end
		end
	end
	local id=if pet then pet.id else nil
	if self.app.selected~=id then self.saleQuote=nil end
	self.app.selected,self.lastSelected=id,id
	self.inspecting,self.showInfo,self.showCapacity=pet~=nil and self.app.gui.AbsoluteSize.X>=660,false,false
	self.placing,self.placingExpected=nil,nil
end

function Browser:Send(action,payload)
	if self.pending then return end
	self.app.audio:Play("Click")
	local id=self.app:Request(action,payload)
	self.pending={id=id,at=os.clock(),action=action,petId=if action=="Sell" and payload then payload.petIds[1] else payload and payload.petId}
	if action~="Sell" then self.saleQuote=nil end
	self.notice=nil
	self:UpdateAction()
end

function Browser:Receive(result)
	if self.pending and result and result.id==self.pending.id then
		local pending=self.pending
		self.pending=nil
		if pending.action=="Sell" then
			self.saleQuote=nil
			if result.ok and (self.app.selected==pending.petId or self.lastSelected==pending.petId) then
				self.app.selected,self.lastSelected,self.inspecting=nil,nil,false
			end
		end
		if pending.action=="UpgradeChicken" and result.ok then self.app.feedback:Action("Income") end
		self.notice=if result.ok then nil else result.message
		self.noticeUntil=os.clock()+4
	end
end

function Browser:UpgradeSelected()
	local pet=self.app:Pet(self.app.selected)
	if not self:CanEdit() or not pet or pet.canUpgrade~=true or type(pet.upgradePrice)~="number"
		or self.app.state.coins<pet.upgradePrice or self.saleQuote then return end
	self:CancelPointer(true);self.placing,self.placingExpected=nil,nil
	self:Send("UpgradeChicken",{petId=pet.id,expectedLevel=pet.level,expectedPrice=pet.upgradePrice})
end

function Browser:SaleEligible(pet)
	return pet~=nil and pet.canSell==true and not pet.selected and not pet.favorite
		and not pet.deployed and pet.home~=false and type(pet.refund)=="number"
		and pet.refund>=0 and pet.refund<math.huge
end

function Browser:SaleQuoteValid()
	local quote=self.saleQuote
	if not quote or self.app.selected~=quote.id or not self.app.state then return false end
	local pet=self.app:Pet(quote.id)
	return self:SaleEligible(pet) and pet.level==quote.level and pet.refund==quote.refund
		and self.app:PetIncome(pet)==quote.income
end

function Browser:ReviewSale()
	local pet=self.app:Pet(self.app.selected)
	if self.pending or not self:SaleEligible(pet) then return end
	self.app.audio:Play("Click");self:CancelPointer(true)
	self.placing,self.placingExpected=nil,nil
	self.saleQuote={id=pet.id,name=Catalog[pet.species].name,level=pet.level,
		refund=pet.refund,income=self.app:PetIncome(pet)}
	self:UpdateAction()
end

function Browser:ConfirmSale()
	if self.pending or not self.root.Visible or not self.parent.Visible then return end
	if not self:SaleQuoteValid() then
		self.saleQuote=nil
		self.notice,self.noticeUntil="Your flock changed. Review the chicken again.",os.clock()+4
		self:UpdateAction();return
	end
	local quote=self.saleQuote
	-- The server rechecks ownership, protection and the exact refund; no stand is required.
	self:Send("Sell",{petIds={quote.id},expectedTotal=quote.refund,sparesOnly=true})
end

function Browser:TogglePet(id)
	if self.pending then return end
	if not self:CanEdit() then
		self.notice,self.noticeUntil="Wait for the current change.",os.clock()+4
		self:UpdateAction();return
	end
	local pet=self.app:Pet(id)
	if not pet then return end
	self.saleQuote=nil
	local ids=self.app.state.selectedIds or {}
	local slot=table.find(ids,id)
	if self.placing then
		if slot then self:Drop(self.placing,slot,false,self.placingExpected or ids) end
	elseif slot then self:Drop(id,nil,true,ids)
	elseif self:ColossalSlot(id) then self:Drop(id,self:ColossalSlot(id),false,ids)
	elseif #ids<self.app.state.capacity then self:Drop(id,#ids+1,false,ids)
	else
		self.app.audio:Play("Click")
		self.placing,self.placingExpected=id,table.clone(ids)
		self.inspecting,self.showInfo=false,false
		self.search.Text="";self.grid.CanvasPosition=Vector2.zero;self:Render(true)
	end
end

function Browser:Drop(id,slot,toFlock,expected)
	if not self:CanEdit() then return end
	local current=self.app.state.selectedIds or {}
	if table.concat(current,"|")~=table.concat(expected,"|") then
		self.notice,self.noticeUntil="Army changed. Choose again.",os.clock()+4
		self:Render(true);return
	end
	local ids=table.clone(expected)
	local old=table.find(ids,id)
	if slot then
		if old==slot then return end
		if old then
			if ids[slot] then ids[old],ids[slot]=ids[slot],id
			else table.remove(ids,old);table.insert(ids,id) end
		else ids[math.min(slot,#ids+1)]=id end
	elseif toFlock and old then table.remove(ids,old)
	else return end
	local colossals=0
	for _,petId in ids do local pet=self.app:Pet(petId);if pet and Giant.IsColossal(pet.giantSize) then colossals+=1 end end
	if colossals>Giant.MaxArmyColossals then
		self.notice,self.noticeUntil="Only 1 Colossal per army. Replace your equipped Colossal.",os.clock()+4
		self:UpdateAction();return
	end
	self.placing,self.placingExpected=nil,nil
	self:Send("SetArmy",{petIds=ids,expectedIds=table.clone(expected)})
end


function Browser:Highlight(target,toFlock)
	for _,entry in self.cards do
		local targetSlot=entry.slot and entry.slot==target
		local viewing=self.inspecting and self.app.selected==entry.id
		entry.border.Color=if targetSlot then WHITE elseif viewing then SELECTED elseif entry.equipped then EQUIPPED else entry.color
		entry.border.Thickness=if targetSlot or viewing then 4 elseif entry.equipped then 3 else 1.8
		if entry.viewing then entry.viewing.Visible=viewing end
		if entry.selectedEdge then entry.selectedEdge.Visible=viewing end
	end
end

function Browser:DropTarget(point)
	if not inside(self.root,point) then return nil,false end
	if not inside(self.grid,point) then return nil,false end
	for index,entry in self.slots do
		if inside(entry.card,point) then return index,false end
	end
	local pointer=self.pointer
	if pointer then
		if table.find(pointer.expected,pointer.id) then return nil,true end
		if #pointer.expected<self.app.state.capacity then return #pointer.expected+1,false end
	end
	return nil,false
end

function Browser:BeginPointer(pet,input)
	local touch=input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch

	if not self:CanEdit() then return end
	if self.saleQuote then self.saleQuote=nil;self:UpdateAction() end
	self:CancelPointer(false)
	local point=pointOf(input)
	local pointer={id=pet.id,input=input,touch=touch,start=point,point=point,
		expected=table.clone(self.app.state.selectedIds or {}),dragging=false}
	self.pointer=pointer
	if touch then
		task.delay(0.22,function()
			if self.pointer==pointer and (pointer.point-pointer.start).Magnitude<10 then self:StartDrag() end
		end)
	end
end

function Browser:PointerChanged(input)
	local pointer=self.pointer
	if not pointer then return end
	if pointer.touch then if input~=pointer.input then return end
	elseif input.UserInputType~=Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then return end
	pointer.point=pointOf(input)
	if not pointer.dragging then
		local distance=(pointer.point-pointer.start).Magnitude
		if pointer.touch and distance>=10 then self:CancelPointer(true);return
		elseif not pointer.touch and distance>=6 then self:StartDrag() end
	end
	if pointer.dragging and pointer.ghost then
		pointer.ghost.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(pointer.point.X-56,pointer.point.Y-70)
		local target,toFlock=self:DropTarget(pointer.point);self:Highlight(target,toFlock)
	end
end

function Browser:PointerEnded(input)
	local pointer=self.pointer
	if not pointer then return end
	if pointer.touch then if input~=pointer.input then return end
	elseif input.UserInputType~=Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then return end
	local target,toFlock=self:DropTarget(pointer.point)
	local dragged=pointer.dragging
	self:CancelPointer(dragged)
	if dragged then
		self:Drop(pointer.id,target,toFlock,pointer.expected)
		self:Render(true)
	end
end

function Browser:Render(force)
	local state=self.app.state
	if not state then return end
	if self.pointer then
		if not self:CanEdit() or not self.app:Pet(self.pointer.id) then self:CancelPointer(true)
		else self:UpdateAction();return end
	end
	local ids=state.selectedIds or {}
	local pets,chosen,ordered={},{},{}
	for _,pet in state.pets or {} do pets[pet.id]=pet;table.insert(ordered,pet) end
	for slot,id in ids do chosen[id]=slot end
	table.sort(ordered,function(a,b)
		if self.sort=="Name" then
			local an,bn=Catalog[a.species].name,Catalog[b.species].name
			if an~=bn then return an<bn end
		end
		local pa,pb=Rules.PetPower(a.species,a.stars,a.level),Rules.PetPower(b.species,b.stars,b.level)
		if pa~=pb then return pa>pb end
		return a.id<b.id
	end)
	if self.app.selected and not pets[self.app.selected] then self.app.selected=nil;self.inspecting=false end
	if self.app.selected and self.app.selected~=self.lastSelected then
		self.inspecting,self.showInfo,self.showCapacity=true,false,false
	end
	self.lastSelected=self.app.selected
	if not self.inspecting or self.showInfo or self.showCapacity or not self.app.selected then self.saleQuote=nil end
	if not self:CanEdit() or (self.placing and not pets[self.placing]) then self.placing,self.placingExpected=nil,nil end
	local dimensions=self:Resize()
	self.app.panelTitle.Text=if self.showInfo then "Army Info"
		elseif self.showCapacity then "More Army Slots" else "Your Chickens!"
	self.title.Text=self.app.panelTitle.Text
	local mode=if state.selectionMode=="Manual" then "Manual lineup" else "Best selected"
	self.summary.Text=string.format('<font color="#F9CE43">%d</font> / %d',#ordered,state.collectionLimit or Config.CollectionLimit)
	self.capacity.Text=string.format('<font color="#F9CE43">%d</font> / %d',#ids,state.capacity)
	self.sortButton.Text=if self.placing then "Cancel" elseif self.sort=="Name" then "Name A-Z" else "Best first"
	local keys={dimensions,self.app.selected or "",table.concat(ids,","),tostring(state.capacity),mode,
		tostring(state.incoming),tostring(state.outgoing),state.armyState,tostring(state.incomeLevel),
		tostring(state.homeEggsPerSecond),self.query,self.sort,self.placing or ""}
	for _,pet in state.pets or {} do
		table.insert(keys,pet.id..":"..pet.species..":"..pet.stars..":"..pet.level..":"..tostring(pet.giantSize)..":"..tostring(pet.home)..":"..tostring(pet.deployed)..":"..tostring(pet.levelCap))
	end
	local key=table.concat(keys,"|")
	if key==self.key and not force then self:UpdateAction();return end
	self.key=key
	local scroll=self.grid.CanvasPosition
	clear(self.grid);self.slots,self.cards={},{}
	local visible={}
	for _,pet in ordered do
		local searchText=string.lower(Catalog[pet.species].name.." "..Catalog[pet.species].rarity.." "..pet.species)
		if self.query=="" or string.find(searchText,self.query,1,true) then table.insert(visible,pet) end
	end
	for index,pet in visible do self:Card(self.grid,pet,chosen[pet.id],self.cellWidth,self.cellHeight,index) end
	self.grid.CanvasPosition=scroll
	if #visible==0 then
		local empty=label(self.grid,"Empty",if self.query~="" then "No matching chickens"
			else "Your flock is empty",
			18,UDim2.new(),UDim2.fromOffset(self.cellWidth,self.cellHeight),MUTED)
		empty.TextWrapped,empty.TextTruncate=true,Enum.TextTruncate.None
		empty.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
	end
	if self.showInfo then self:RenderArmyInfo(pets,ids) end
	self:RenderDetail(pets[self.app.selected])
	self:Highlight(nil,false);self:UpdateAction()
end

function AppController:Request(action, payload)

		local offer=self.state and self.state.boardUpgrades and self.state.boardUpgrades[productionKey]
		if offer then

			self.productionRequests[request.id]={key=productionKey,level=offer.level,currentText=offer.currentText,

function AppController:NoticePosition()
	-- Menu feedback sits over the dimmed HUD, away from purchase controls.
	local height=self.gui.AbsoluteSize.Y
	local noticeHeight=self.toastFrame.Size.Y.Scale*height+self.toastFrame.Size.Y.Offset
	local top=math.max(if self.panel.Visible then 82 else height*0.24,noticeHeight+12)

end

function AppController:SizeNotice()
	local available=self.gui.AbsoluteSize
	if available.X<=0 or available.Y<=0 then return end
	local width=math.max(48,math.min(720,available.X-24))
	local compact=available.X<700 or available.Y<500
	local outline=if compact then 2.5 else 3
	self.toast:SetAttribute("OutlineThickness",outline)
	self.toast.TextSize=if compact then 28 else 34
	self.toast.TextOutline.Thickness=outline
	local bounds=TextService:GetTextSize(self.toast:GetAttribute("PlainText") or "",self.toast.TextSize,
		self.toast.Font,Vector2.new(width-24,10000))
	-- Wrap naturally instead of shrinking text or clipping two-line receipts.
	self.toastFrame.Size=UDim2.fromScale(width/available.X,math.max(52,bounds.Y+24)/available.Y)
end

function AppController:Notify(text, ok)
	if not text or text == "" then return end
	local kind=if type(ok)=="string" and Theme.NotificationStyles[ok] then ok
		elseif ok==false then "error" elseif ok==true then "success" else "info"
	if kind=="error" then
		self.audio:Play("Error",nil,{voiceKey="ErrorNotification",cooldown=0.25})
	end
	local repeated=self.toastFrame.Visible and self.noticeText==text and self.noticeKind==kind
	self.noticeText,self.noticeKind=text,kind
	self.toastSerial += 1
	local serial = self.toastSerial
	Theme.SetNotification(self.toast,text,kind)
	self:SizeNotice()
	Theme.Motion:Toast(self.toastFrame,true,self:NoticePosition(),repeated)
	if self.toastDelay then task.cancel(self.toastDelay) end
	local duration=math.clamp(#text/24+1,if kind=="error" or kind=="warning" then 5 else 4,8)
	self.toastDelay=task.delay(duration, function()
		self.toastDelay=nil
		if self.alive and serial == self.toastSerial then Theme.Motion:Toast(self.toastFrame,false) end
	end)
end

function AppController:Pet(id)
	if not self.state or not id then return nil end
	for _, pet in self.state.pets do if pet.id == id then return pet end end
	return nil
end

function AppController:TrackProductionUpgrade(result)
	if result.action~="BoardUpgrade" and result.action~="Income" then return false end
	if self.productionReceipts[result.id] then return true,false end
	local requested=self.productionRequests[result.id]
	if not requested then return false end
	self.productionRequests[result.id]=nil
	if not result.ok then return false end
	self.productionReceipts[result.id]=os.clock()+600
	local offer=self.state.boardUpgrades and self.state.boardUpgrades[requested.key]
	if not offer or offer.level~=requested.level+1 then
		self:Notify(result.message,true)
		return true,true
	end
	local name=if requested.key=="EggSpeed" then "Egg Speed" else "Egg Value"
	local benefit=if requested.key=="EggSpeed" then "Every chicken produces more eggs" else "Same value for every new egg"
	self:Notify(name..": "..requested.currentText.." → "..offer.currentText.."\n"..benefit,true)
	return true,true
end

-- Purchase classification describes selection, not a bird arriving at a battle.
-- Keep that identity independently of any encounter so late replication and a
-- later first deployment cannot drop the acknowledgement or replay an old one.
function AppController:TrackRecruit(result)
	local recruit, id = result.recruit, result.petId
	if type(recruit) ~= "table" or type(id) ~= "string"
		or (recruit.assignment ~= "Added" and recruit.assignment ~= "Replacement" and recruit.assignment ~= "Reserve") then return false end
	if self.recruitReceipts[id] then return true, false end
	local now = os.clock()
	self.recruitReceipts[id] = now + 600
	local pet = self:Pet(id)
	local definition = pet and Catalog[pet.species]
	local name = definition and definition.name or "Chicken"
	local assignment = recruit.assignment
	self.recruitIntents[id] = {petId = id, assignment = assignment, createdAt = now, expiresAt = now + 600,
		pendingBattleId = recruit.pendingBattleId, deferred = recruit.deferredUntilContestEnds == true,
		selectedOnce = assignment ~= "Reserve",
		homeAcknowledged = false, arrivalAcknowledged = false, contributionAcknowledged = false}
	local classification
	if assignment == "Reserve" then
		classification = "Reserve"
	else
		classification = if assignment == "Added" and type(recruit.selectedBefore) == "number" and type(recruit.selectedAfter) == "number"
			then "Squad " .. recruit.selectedBefore .. " → " .. recruit.selectedAfter else assignment
		if recruit.deferredUntilContestEnds then classification ..= " · joins after this contest"
		elseif recruit.pendingBattleId then classification ..= " · marching" end
	end
	-- Per-bird potential, not a promise of net home income or cash paid immediately.
	local identity=name
	if pet and type(pet.eggsPerSecond)=="number" then
		local width=math.max(1,self.toast.AbsoluteSize.X)
		identity=EggFeedback.Fit(pet.eggsPerSecond,name.." · "," eggs/s at home",width,self.toast.TextSize,false,true)
		if EggFeedback.Width(identity,self.toast.TextSize)>width then
			identity=EggFeedback.Fit(pet.eggsPerSecond,name.." · "," eggs/s",width,self.toast.TextSize,false,true)
		end
		-- Preserve identity and assignment if a very narrow viewport cannot fit the optional rate.
		if EggFeedback.Width(identity,self.toast.TextSize)>width then identity=name end
	end
	local text=identity.."\n"..classification
	self:Notify(text, true)
	self.feedback:Action("Buy")
	-- Bound presentation history independently of inventory size.
	local count, oldestId, oldest = 0, nil, math.huge
	for petId, intent in self.recruitIntents do
		count += 1
		if intent.createdAt < oldest then oldestId, oldest = petId, intent.createdAt end
	end
	if count > 24 and oldestId then self.recruitIntents[oldestId] = nil end
	return true, true
end

function AppController:StepRecruitFeedback()
	if not self.state then return end
	local now = os.clock()
	for id, expires in self.recruitReceipts do if now >= expires then self.recruitReceipts[id] = nil end end
	for id, expires in self.productionReceipts do if now >= expires then self.productionReceipts[id] = nil end end
	for id, request in self.productionRequests do if now >= request.expiresAt then self.productionRequests[id] = nil end end
	for id, intent in self.recruitIntents do
		local pet = self:Pet(id)
		if now >= intent.expiresAt or not pet then self.recruitIntents[id] = nil;continue end
		if intent.deferred then
			-- Buy confirms the active lock. BattleChanged uses another stream and
			-- may still cache the same encounter's earlier, unlocked NPC approach.
			-- Release on the state transition (or the actual new unit below), not
			-- that older snapshot. Same-ID holding can still confirm real arrival.
			if self.state.outgoing ~= intent.pendingBattleId or self.state.armyState == "Home" then intent.deferred = false end
		end
		if self:IsSelected(pet) then intent.selectedOnce = true
		elseif intent.selectedOnce then
			-- A better later roll can supersede a recruit before it arrives.
			self.recruitIntents[id] = nil;continue
		end
		if pet.home and not intent.homeAcknowledged and not intent.deferred then
			local model = self.base:HomePet(id)
			if model and model:IsA("Model") and model.PrimaryPart then
				intent.homeAcknowledged = true
				self.base:PulseModel(model, C.gold)
			end
		end
	end
end

function AppController:ObserveRecruitUnit(battle, unit, model)
	local intent = unit.petId and self.recruitIntents[unit.petId]
	local state = self.state
	if not intent or not state or state.outgoing ~= battle.id then return end
	local side = if battle.attacker == state.userId then "A" elseif battle.defender == state.userId then "B" else nil
	if not side or unit.side ~= side or not model or not model.PrimaryPart then return end
	if intent.deferred and battle.rosterLocked then return end
	if battle.phase ~= "Fight" and battle.phase ~= "Capture" and battle.phase ~= "Holding" then return end
	if (unit.hp or 0) <= 0 or unit.reinforcing or unit.retiring then return end
	local pet = self:Pet(unit.petId)
	if not pet or not self:IsSelected(pet) then return end
	intent.selectedOnce = true
	-- Both authoritative coordinates and the displayed rig must be at the site.
	local radius = battle.captureRadius or Config.CaptureRadius
	local position = model.PrimaryPart.Position
	if (unit.x - battle.x)^2 + (unit.z - battle.z)^2 > radius^2
		or (position.X - battle.x)^2 + (position.Z - battle.z)^2 > radius^2 then return end
	if intent.battleId ~= battle.id then
		intent.battleId = battle.id
		intent.pendingBattleId = nil
		intent.deferred = false
	end
	if not intent.arrivalAcknowledged then
		intent.arrivalAcknowledged = true
		self.base:PulseModel(model, C.blue)
		if os.clock() - (self.lastRecruitArrivalNotice or -10) > 1.2 then
			self.lastRecruitArrivalNotice = os.clock()
			self:Notify((Catalog[pet.species] and Catalog[pet.species].name or "Chicken") .. " joined your army", true)
		end
	end
	if not intent.contributionAcknowledged and (unit.impactSerial or 0) > 0 then
		-- This may be the first replicated view after a hit already occurred. A
		-- quiet bird emphasis confirms it; never replay that old hit or sound.
		intent.contributionAcknowledged = true
		self.base:PulseModel(model, C.gold)
		self.recruitIntents[unit.petId] = nil
	end
end

function AppController:Counts()
	local state = self.state or {}
	local count = state.count or #(state.pets or {})
	local capacity = state.capacity or Config.StartingSlots
	local selected = state.selectedCount
	if selected == nil then selected = if state.selectedIds then #state.selectedIds else math.min(count, capacity) end
	local deployed = state.deployedCount
	if deployed == nil then
		deployed = if state.deployedIds then #state.deployedIds elseif state.armyState and state.armyState ~= "Home" then state.deployed or 0 else 0
	end
	return count, state.collectionLimit or Config.CollectionLimit, capacity, selected, deployed
end

function AppController:PetIncome(pet)
	if type(pet.income) == "number" then return pet.income end
	return Rules.Income(pet.species,pet.stars or 1,pet.level,self.state.incomeLevel or 0)
end

function AppController:IsSelected(pet)
	if pet.selected ~= nil then return pet.selected == true end
	if self.state.selectedIds then return table.find(self.state.selectedIds, pet.id) ~= nil end
	return pet.slot ~= nil
end

function AppController:IsDeployed(pet)
	if pet.deployed ~= nil then return pet.deployed == true end
	if self.state.deployedIds then return table.find(self.state.deployedIds, pet.id) ~= nil end
	return self.state.armyState ~= "Home" and pet.slot ~= nil
end

function AppController:Groups()
	local groups, byKey = {}, {}
	for _, pet in self.state.pets or {} do
		local key = groupKey(pet)
		local group = byKey[key]
		if not group then
			group = {key = key, species = pet.species, stars = pet.stars, level = pet.level or 1, pets = {}, sellable = {}, ready = 0, deployed = 0, favorites = 0, income = 0}
			byKey[key] = group;table.insert(groups, group)
		end
		table.insert(group.pets, pet)
		if self:IsSelected(pet) then group.ready += 1 end
		if self:IsDeployed(pet) then group.deployed += 1 end
		if pet.canSell == true then table.insert(group.sellable, pet) end
		if pet.favorite then group.favorites += 1;group.favorite = group.favorite or pet end
		group.income += self:PetIncome(pet)
	end
	for _, group in groups do
		table.sort(group.sellable, function(a, b) return a.id < b.id end)
		group.representative = group.sellable[1] or group.favorite or group.pets[1]
		group.protected = #group.pets - #group.sellable
	end
	table.sort(groups, function(a, b)
		local ap, bp = Rules.PetPower(a.species, a.stars, a.level), Rules.PetPower(b.species, b.stars, b.level)
		if ap ~= bp then return ap > bp end
		return a.key < b.key
	end)
	return groups, byKey
end

	local merging=self.page=="Merge" and self.mergeBrowser~=nil

	local upgrading=self.page=="Upgrades"
	self.progression.root.Visible=upgrading
	self.content.Visible,self.chickenBrowser.root.Visible=not browsing and not merging and not shopping and not indexing and not upgrading,browsing
	if self.mergeBrowser then self.mergeBrowser.root.Visible=merging end
	self.panelHeader.Visible,self.panelBody.Visible=not shopping and not browsing and not upgrading and not merging,not shopping and not browsing and not upgrading and not merging
	self.standardPage.Visible=not shopping and not browsing and not upgrading and not merging
	self.shopBrowser.root.Visible,self.indexBrowser.root.Visible=shopping,indexing
	if upgrading then
		self:FitPanel();self.progression:Render();return
	end
	if shopping then
		self.panelTitle.Text="Shop!";self:FitPanel();self.shopBrowser:Render(force);return
	end
	if indexing then
		self.panelTitle.Text="Chicken Index!";self:FitPanel();self.indexBrowser:Render(force);return
	end
	if merging then
		self.panelTitle.Text="Fuse Chickens"
		self:FitPanel();self.mergeBrowser:Render(force)
		return
	end
	if browsing then
		self.panelTitle.Text="Your Chickens!"
		self:FitPanel()
		self.chickenBrowser:Render(force)
		return
	end
	local state = self.state
	local keys = {self.page, tostring(self.selected), tostring(self.confirm), tostring(state.capacity), tostring(state.luck), tostring(state.incomeLevel), state.armyState, tostring(state.campsWon),tostring(state.incoming)}

		table.insert(keys, tostring(state.shop and state.shop.testAllowed))
		table.insert(keys, tostring(state.shop and state.shop.testPreset))
	end
	local key = table.concat(keys, "|")
	if not force and key == self.panelKey then return end

function AppController:Receive(packet)
	if type(packet) ~= "table" or type(packet.state) ~= "table" then return end
	local old = self.state
	self.state = packet.state
	local state = self.state
	self.eggs:Receive(state.eggs)
	if not old or old.plotIndex ~= state.plotIndex then self.base:RefreshPromptOwnership() end
	if self.selected and not self:Pet(self.selected) then
		local previous
		for _, pet in (old and old.pets) or {} do if pet.id == self.selected then previous = pet;break end end
		self.selected, self.confirm = nil, nil
		if previous then
			local _, byKey = self:Groups()
			local group = byKey[groupKey(previous)]
			if group then self.selected = group.representative.id end
		end
	end
	local result = packet.result
	if result and not self.mergeBrowser and (result.action=="OpenMerge" or result.action=="Merge" or result.action=="MergeAll") then result=nil end
	local shownRecruit, newRecruit = false, false
	local shownProduction,newProduction=false,false
	if result then shownProduction,newProduction=self:TrackProductionUpgrade(result) end
	self.chickenBrowser:Receive(result)
	if self.mergeBrowser then self.mergeBrowser:Receive(result) end
	self.commerce:Receive(result)
	self.progression:Receive(result)
	self.upgradeBoard:Receive(result)
	self.eggBoard:Receive(result)
	if result and result.action~="RefreshShop" and result.action~="PreparePurchase" then
		local shownInMerge=result.action=="OpenMerge" or ((result.action=="Merge" or result.action=="MergeAll") and self.page=="Merge" and self.panel.Visible)
  if result.ok and result.action=="Buy" then shownRecruit,newRecruit=self:TrackRecruit(result) end
  if not shownProduction and not (result.ok and (result.action=="Roll" or shownInMerge or shownRecruit)) then self:Notify(result.message,result.ok) end
		if result.ok and result.action == "Buy" and not shownRecruit then self.feedback:Action("Buy");self.base:PetPulse(result.petId, C.gold) end
		if result.ok and (result.action == "Sell" or result.action == "Promote") then self.feedback:Action(result.action) end
		if result.ok and result.action == "OpenMerge" then self:OpenPage("Merge") end
		if result.ok and (result.action == "Merge" or result.action == "MergeAll") then
			self.base:PetPulse(result.petId,C.gold)
		end
		if result.ok and (result.action == "Income" or result.action == "Luck" or result.action == "Expand")
			and (not shownProduction or newProduction) then self.feedback:Action(result.action) end
		if result.ok and result.action == "Attack" then self:ClosePanel() end
	end
	local count, limit, capacity, selectedCount, deployedCount = self:Counts()
	self.hud:Update(state, count, limit, capacity, selectedCount, deployedCount)
	self.base:UpdateObjective()
	self:StepRecruitFeedback()
	if state.banner and state.banner ~= "" and state.banner ~= self.lastBanner then self:Notify(state.banner);self.lastBanner = state.banner end
	if old and state.lastResult ~= old.lastResult and not packet.result then self:Notify(state.lastResult) end
	self:RenderPanel(old == nil)
	self.offlineCash:Receive(state)
	if result and result.ok then
		local changed=if (result.action=="Expand" or result.action=="Income" or result.action=="Luck")
			and (not shownProduction or newProduction) then self.progression.row else nil
		if changed then
			local name=if result.action=="Expand" then "Capacity" else result.action
			local card=changed:FindFirstChild(name)
			if card and card:FindFirstChild("Icon") then Theme.Motion:Pop(card.Icon,1.18) end
		end
		-- Keep reward motion local to the action, not behind notification text.
		if result.action=="Sell" then Theme.Motion:Pop(self.hud.cashIcon,1.14) end
	end
end

		if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Escape and self.panel.Visible then self:ClosePanel() end
	end))
	self:Request("Sync")
	print("[PetRoll] My Chicken Army! client ready")
end
